nom: TULA A+ Renewal Advanced Retinal & Peptides Serum

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some who reacted poorly to other retinol or retinal products in the past, mostly report gentle tolerance with little to no irritation, though a few describe itchiness or mild redness that led them to stop using it.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report the serum doesn't over-dry their skin, hydrating drier areas while leaving oilier areas unaffected.
segments.oily: The few reviewers with naturally oily skin report the serum can still dry out their skin if overused, so they apply it cautiously, while one says the retinol balances well against her oiliness.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin reports smoother, more even, subtly glowing skin with no irritation or dryness after a few weeks.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report smoother texture, fewer visible fine lines, and firmer-looking skin within a few weeks to months of consistent use, though several say it's too early to judge results or that they haven't noticed a strong anti-aging effect yet.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers report the serum helped fade acne-related hyperpigmentation and calm active breakouts faster, and several beginners experienced an initial purging period of whiteheads and blackheads; one reviewer's breakouts returned once she stopped using the product.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no redness even on first use, but a few describe temporary redness around the nose or a reaction requiring discontinued use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the serum as non-drying compared to other retinol or retinal products they've tried, often citing it as gentle enough to skip a separate moisturizer.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report lighter hyperpigmentation and acne scarring, including dark spots that had not responded to other treatments, though results are described as gradual.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers credit the ceramide and aloe content with reducing the irritation and dryness they associate with retinol products generally.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight, fast-absorbing texture with no greasy residue
Pricey for the amount of product
Pump can become hard to dispense from near the bottle's end

extraits.titre: This wasn't the best for my skin
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wanted to love this but it just wasn't for me. The packaging was easy to use…just one good pump and enough product was dispensed to cover most of my face. The texture of the cream was smooth and glided with ease across my face. There was no noticeable scent for me. Unfortunately, this irritated my skin. My face felt itchy after using this cream, so even though I tried to tough it out and keep with it, the itchiness was too much for me to continue usage.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using Tula's retinol for a few weeks now and I'm really impressed. It's gentle on my skin—no peeling or irritation—and I've noticed my skin looks smoother and more even. I love that it combines retinol with probiotics, so it feels nourishing rather than harsh. Great for anyone looking for a beginner-friendly retinol that actually works.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I tested this product for over a month so I could provide honest feedback. I'll start by saying this is the best retinal I've used to date. I have sensitive skin, and past retinal products have cause dermatitis. But not this one! I've used it once a week for over a month and my skin's been a lot clearer and looks more youthful. I've also noticed that a lot of my hyperpigmentation has subsided. I definitely will he using this product for time to come. I also really love the packaging - the bottle is heavy and feels super high quality.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've used Tula A+ renewal advanced Retinal +pepsides serum 3 times a week and noticed my skins texture is smoother, my face looks more radiant. It has a gentle formula, which is suitable if you have sensitive skin. This is my 1st time trying a product with retinoid products, so the first week it seemed like my skin purged. The serum provides hydrating components which is a plus. Since trying this product I've noticed I'm more confident in walking out the house in my most natural state without makeup. My biggest concerns was my hyperpigmentation and I've noticed my acne scars ar lighter. I love this product and will be continuing to use this in my weekly routine. I don't notice a scent to this product but the packaging is cute. The packaging is durable, even distribution with the pump which avoids any mess.

extraits.titre: Surprised me in a good way
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have skin that tends to break out frequently, and while I've been recommended retinols before, my previous experience with them led to even more breakouts. Still, I decided to give it another try. After about a week of using this product, I noticed a significant improvement—my skin started clearing up nicely. However, once I stopped, the breakouts returned. I'm not sure if that's just my skin's natural tendency or the absence of the product, but either way, I plan to keep using it. The formula is lightweight, not greasy or oily, and feels great on the skin. Plus, the packaging is adorable and looks great on my bathroom shelf.

I was very excited to receive this product for testing as i am familiar with other products from this brand. The product is amazing starting with ingredients which are rated 100/100. The product is amazing. I am struggling with redness, dryness and sensitivity, but this product was gentle enough to improve my skin without having any breakouts from retinoids. It's like magic outside Hogwarts. Will definitely repurchase🤍
